power_dragent_counts.source_locator: PDF p.6 Table IV and p.8 Appendix; score definitions p.5 Table II; Q6 exception p.7 footnote 8
power_dragent_counts.caption: Correct answers (score >=2), reconstructed from Table IV and Appendix; n=18 DR cases per question. Q6 includes correctly labeled duration under footnote 8. Counts are author-data-derived, not an independent rerun.
power_dragent_counts.assumptions: 18 disturbance-record cases, not 18 repeated stochastic trials per case. Scores were manually assessed by a domain expert. Baseline and agent use different prompt/context workflows. The comparison does not isolate one component causally. Do not describe the Q6 result as 13/18 correct clearance timestamps. Q6 printed mean is inconsistent; audited cell counts are used instead.
power_dragent_counts.credit: Original educational plot derived from published DrAgent score cells; no experiments rerun.
